query: UPDATE status_stats SET favourites_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favourites WHERE status_id = $1), untrusted_favourites_count = CASE WHEN untrusted_favourites_count IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(GREATEST(untrusted_favourites_count + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favourites WHERE status_id = $1) - favourites_count, 0), 100000000) END, updated_at = now() WHERE status_id = $1
